solana_notes: Rent is a refundable deposit proportional to allocated bytes plus a 128-byte metadata overhead; the program never hard-codes it (Rent::get()) because the schedule changes (SIMD-0437).

Closing an account on Solana means moving its lamports out, zeroing and resizing its data and reassigning it to the system program; a second close sees a system-owned empty account, which the program reports as AlreadyClosed.
PDAs that are "permanent" (registry/snapshot pages) are a policy choice enforced by NotClosable, not a runtime property.
